comments.text:
Completed implementation of the osaka-jade theme:
- Added standalone static/themes/osaka-jade.css based on Antharchy/Omarchy osaka-jade color palette.
- Added "osaka-jade" to AVAILABLE_THEMES in markusmd.themes.
- Added [data-theme="osaka-jade"] styles to static/markus.css.
- Added BDD feature scenarios in features/themes.feature and updated features/site.feature.
- Verified with behave (all 83 scenarios passing), ruff lint, and demo site build.
